events.title: We are Announcing our Early Access Launch Price
events.summary: We are announcing our price ahead of our EA release which is ...(Drumroll) ... $24.99 with a 20% launch discount ($19.99), launching October 28! It's important to us that the price for the game remains accessible for most, and we feel this price reaches a solid balance between maintaining that accessibility, and still meeting the studios goals and needs to keep things moving forward. events.title: Last Minute Changes and Polish Ahead of Next Fest
events.summary: Last Minute Changes and Polish Ahead of Next FestThis update includes hotfixes, Qol, top requests, balancing and combat, and some last minute polish and UI changes as we get ready for steam's next fest event starting tomorrow! Please follow us on discord to keep up with the latest, chat with devs, and talk with the community. As we head into next fest, any feedback and bug reporting about the game on top of what we have already is greatly appreciated (More than you might ever know or think haha)

events.title: Updated 75 min Playtest Demo Available!
events.summary: We've Updated Our Free 75 Minute Demo!We've Updated Our Latest Demo on Steam! Players now get 75 minutes. Additionally, the timer no longer counts down during dialogue or cutscenes so there's no need to rush through those moments. This to progress through the story and quest lines as they were intended to be enjoyed, without feeling rushed. This update also includes some additional general fixes and improvements. This demo is available for free from now until the end of our Kickstarter campaign,

events.title: Playtest Hotfix - March 21
events.summary: Hotfix Patchnotes!Our playtest has been going strong this weekend -- with many players already succeeding in breaking the game... yay? Thankfully, our devs are hard at work getting some major fixes in before the playtest ends. Look below to see what's fixed!Major Fixes and Changes* The defense skill now functions as intended.* Fixed some errors causing Single Player to not work correctly - starting a singleplayer server should now work!* Coins are no longer required for Desolate Zone upgrades.*
